name: SpellBooks
description: Adds five castable magic spell books - fireball, mending, blink, storm, and frost - that players get with a command and cast by right-clicking.
usage: Run /spellbook fireball, then right-click to hurl a blazing fireball
manual: Type /spellbook followed by a spell name - fireball, heal, blink, lightning, or frost - to receive that enchanted spell book in your inventory. Hold the book and right-click to cast its spell: fireball launches a fiery projectile, heal restores your health, blink teleports you forward through the air, lightning calls down a bolt where you're looking, and frost freezes everything living nearby. Every spell shares a cooldown controlled by cooldown-seconds (default 5, from 1 to 60) so you can't spam-cast. Fireball's blast strength is set by fireball-power (default 1.5), heal restores heal-amount health points per cast (default 6.0), blink reaches up to blink-distance blocks forward (default 8), and frost freezes creatures within frost-radius blocks (default 5.0) for frost-slow-seconds seconds of slowness (default 6). All six knobs are read live from the config book or /vibe gui, so changes apply on your very next cast. Each spell comes with fitting particles and sounds to make casting feel powerful.
creator: player

versions.prompt: add magic spell books to the game, be creative, add some nice spells
